title: pilosella galiciensis
intro: Pilosella galiciensis, commonly known as Galician mouse-ear, is a perennial plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, exhibiting health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella galiciensis are attributed to its ability to inhibit histone deacetylases, which may contribute to its potential in the treatment of various diseases, including cancer and neurodegenerative disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
